title: Decision: TowerToHyperService bridge in TLS accept loop
description: main.rs uses TowerToHyperService::new(svc) to adapt the axum/Tower service for hyper 1.x. hyper 1.x defines its own Service trait (hyper::service::Service) that is incompatible with tower::Service; TowerToHyperService is the correct bridge. Without it, the types do not unify and the connection cannot be served. This is non-obvious because hyper 0.x and Tower shared a Service trait, so the bridge requirement is new in hyper 1.x.
